findings.title: avail fails structurally: 48.0 % own (49.4 % claimed); 17/48 runs never launch
findings.detail: Launched runs 74.374 %; every tail ≥3.5 case and tail3 s11/s13 refused; tail band 3.5–5.5 = 0 %. Pre-run wind history (dev request) only recovers the 4 cross s13 first rides → 53.1 %. Upper bound if everything flew ≈74–76 %: cannot reach 80 % even then.

findings.title: Off-grid crosswind 7.5 m/s: headClear 0.934 m with the gate on
findings.detail: crossL7.5_s11: deep-stall drop at the final stop passes 0.934 m from helmetAt while the rider stands (KE 13.7 J). Dev reported it in offGridOther but claims "safe in all 48"; the safety claim is grid-bound like round 3.

findings.title: Jitter pass depends on an ASSUMED ≥6 Hz loaded servo bandwidth
findings.detail: Servo model is now physical (dead band, backlash, slew, PWM, latency) — A3-TG-04 substantively addressed — but 4 Hz → p90 4.437 °/s, 3 Hz → 6.297. No datasheet bandwidth for a 2.5 g servo with a 27 g camera; mount pointing commanded from the true LOS.

findings.title: Endurance pass rests on a 0.05 W lift sleep
findings.detail: Recomputed 53.09 (exact). 0.15 W → 49.59, 0.3 W → 45.14, 0.5 W → 40.31 (FAIL), idle → 38.26. The dev's own pre-history request needs the wind estimator awake ≥10 s before push-off (geofence wake at the lift top is enough; continuous on-lift sensing is not compatible with 0.05 W). Camera/boost wake latency (≈2–4 s) is not modelled but fits inside the launch sequence.

findings.title: Artefact check under-counts: leash tested at vertices only, wand omitted
findings.detail: Own densified projection: leash ≥2 px over the body in 1.649 % of riding samples (near-camera segment, z 0.3–0.6 m, 3–13 px, strongly defocused), wand (Ø3 mm, p50 1.45 px, max 2.57 px) 0.395 %; avail −1.4 pp; literal bounding-box reading −6.7 pp.

findings.title: Wand missing from mass budget; wand distance overstated
findings.detail: WORN omits the 8 g wand (0.457 → 0.465 kg, still pass). Min distance of the worn rod (hinge to eyelet) to helmetAt 1.165 m, not the 1.36 m quoted for the eyelet.

findings.title: Pre-run wind history request: small avail gain, KE margin shrinks
findings.detail: With a 10 s pre-run window: 4 cross s13 runs fly their first ride (avail 53.1 %); no tail refusal changes; KE max 14.198 J (crossR6_s13, 0.7 J margin).

findings.title: Tail 3–6 m/s off-grid (0.25 steps, gate on) is safe because it is refused
findings.detail: 39 runs: 2 launched (tail3/3.25 s12: KE ≤12.47 J, headClear 1.356 m, avail 37 %), the rest refused; fixes A3-TG-01 for these seeds at the cost of avail.

findings.title: Trip exposure higher with the wand
findings.detail: Line p10 ≈0.45 m at 1–2 m behind the feet; ≥5 cm of line below 0.3 m in 20.3 % of riding-with-line time (7.4 % with the round-3 holster). Resort permission gate.

safetyRegulatory: <250 g UAS on a 15 m conductive leash: EU C0/A1 operator registration; US VLOS; resort written permission is a hard gate
Leash ≈0.45 m above the snow 1–2 m behind the rider: trip/clothesline exposure for crossing skiers
Off-grid 7.5 m/s crosswind deep-stall drop 0.93 m from a standing rider's helmet
48 V on a 0.6 mm line: insulation abrasion / snag fault handling unverified
credibleEnvelope: Simulation-credible only as a light-wind camera: estimated tailwind <3 m/s, head/cross ≤6 m/s (9 m/s on grid seeds only; 7.5 m/s cross showed a 0.93 m head pass), carving rider 8–13 m/s on ≤20°, low-traffic pistes with permission; footage quality conditional on a ≥6 Hz loaded servo mount; endurance on a ≤0.3 W lift sleep.
verdict: Reproduces exactly (48/48). Fails avail honestly and structurally (own 48.0 %, claimed 49.4 %; tail ≥3.5 m/s refused by design; even perfect flying of all cases tops out ≈75 %). Safe on the judged grid (KE 13.22 J, headClear 1.061 m) and in the off-grid tail band (by refusal), but not at crosswind 7.5 m/s (0.934 m). Jitter 2.45 °/s rests on an assumed ≥6 Hz servo; endurance 53 min on an optimistic 0.05 W sleep. Not usable as an all-conditions solo follow-cam; a light-wind research concept.
